current_configuration.source: authenticated GET /v1/security/firewall/config with exact projectId and teamId

rule_contract.condition: host ninc exact verified deployment hostname array
rule_contract.maintenance: allow only explicitly selected immutable artifact hosts; public alias remains denied
rule_contract.release: add canonical public alias only after its deployment ID resolves to an explicitly selected artifact

safety_controls: Dry-run by default; GET requests only
Fixed App/API project IDs and team
Exact deployment ID, project, READY status and supplied 40-character SHA are checked
No wildcard or arbitrary unverified host is accepted
Existing unrelated draft is never overwritten
Existing rules and firewall settings are preserved and compared before activation
Reviewed plan digest required for staging or activation
Stage and activate are separate explicit invocations
Original configuration saved with DPAPI before mutation
Activation targets the exact reviewed numeric version
Activated configuration is read back and compared

validation.live_app_dry_run: passed against an existing READY deployment identity; no release host selection is implied
validation.live_api_dry_run: passed against an existing READY deployment identity; no release host selection is implied

cases: stage changes draft only, no activation
altered or bypass draft rejects before activation
activation pins reviewed numeric version and verifies readback

remaining_execution_proof: Activate only during the coordinated release window. Probe every inventory hostname with the applicable authorized Deployment Protection session, including an old Production artifact, old Preview artifact and branch aliases; confirm denied hosts never reach runtime. Anonymous SSO redirects occur before project WAF and are not themselves a WAF denial. Test the new allowed host still requires normal auth. Recheck inventory and active rule before migrations and before opening public aliases.
primary_sources: Official installed Vercel CLI commands-bulk.js: patchFirewallDraft uses PATCH /config/draft; activateFirewallConfig uses POST /config/{version}/activate
